How to Draw a Cat

Easy Drawing for Kids in 6 Steps

Six big steps from one circle to a finished cat. All you need is paper, a pencil and your favorite colors — crayons work too.

Step 1 of 6

You drew a cat!

Draw a dog next Back to Activities

For grown-ups: Sit together and draw side by side. A wobbly circle makes the friendliest cat. Paper, a pencil and something to color with are all this lesson needs.
